title: task.update_status — Request
description: Mutate a task's status. Idempotent via operation_id; concurrency-safe via if_match. Writes a 'status_changed' event before updating the materialized status field.

if_match.description: The client's known task version. If it does not match the server's current version, the server returns 409 Conflict with the server's current task body.
